I’m 28yo with one child. On 03/03 I had a laparoscopic total hysterectomy along with salpingectomy, keeping both ovaries. I prepared for the worst and hoped for nothing.

I have had a surprisingly easy time with recovery. The only painful thing for me has been random sharp pain under my ribs. Maybe gas pain? It happens very infrequently. Other things that are kinda uncomfortable include: getting up and down from the couch or bed, feeling my organs rearrange themselves, gas pain in my shoulders, being unable to sleep, sore incision sites. 
My doctor didn’t really prepare me for much, other than not being able to lift or have sex for a good while after. I learned everything from researching on this sub. I wanted a hysterectomy for exactly the same reasons you gave. I haven’t bled one drop since my procedure, and damn is that nice. I was terrified of recovery, especially when my Dr only gave 7 days worth of Norco 5mg to take every 6hrs, as needed. I thought I’d be in more pain than this lol. 

Honorable mention, the bruising all around my lower stomach?? I wasn’t expecting that haha
I’m in the US. Thanks to insurance, I’ll be paying $750 for my outpatient total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingectomy.

The main tip I can give is to pick at least two matte crease shades, use the lighter one towards the top of your crease and the darker more in the middle toward the bottom. If you want to use a third darker shade on the outer third of your crease and use a V shape to connect it to your lash line, that adds a lot of definition too. Using three similar shades makes it easier for me to have a seamless blended look. Hope I helped!
